chunks: Al-Khalil ibn Ahmad told me, saying: Ibn Muni'a narrated to us, saying: Ali ibn Isa al-Makhrami narrated to us in the year thirty-one, saying: Khallad ibn Isa narrated to us, from Thabit, from Anas, who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said:
Good character is half of the religion.

key_terms.حُسْنُ الْخُلُقِ: Good character or excellent moral conduct

ai.seo_question: What does the Prophet mean when he says good character is half of the religion?
ai.summary: In al-Khisal, Shaykh al-Saduq highlights this hadith to underscore that moral excellence is not merely a supplementary virtue but a foundational pillar equal in weight to ritual observance. This narration reflects the Shia emphasis on the integration of inner piety and outward behavior, suggesting that good character serves as the practical manifestation of faith. The statement implies that while belief is the root, ethical conduct is the visible structure that sustains the religious edifice.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 1-106 Al-Khalil ibn Ahmad narrated that Ibn Muni’a quoted on the authority of Ali ibn Isa al-Mokhrami in the year 130 A.H. (747 A.D.), on the authority of Khilad ibn Isa, on the authority of Sabit, on the authority of Anas that God’s Prophet (MGB) said, “
Being good-tempered constitutes half of the religion.”
